author: BBGH
content: Resolved all 12 open questions across 7 design docs. Decisions: defer voice mode, git CLI for everything (removed git2), runtime USER_TYPE gating for internal features, separate ToolRenderer trait in claude-tui, Arc<Mutex> for ToolUseContext, open crate for browser, always include ant-only fields, bounded mpsc channel (256) for streaming backpressure, ratatui-image for inline images, immediate-mode re-render every frame, tree-sitter for bash security, nucleo crate with tuned params. All 16 docs now fully resolved: 149 REQs, 140 ACs, 0 OPEN.
